about.headline:
Behind
the camera
about.lead: I'm Wilson — an Indonesian photographer based in the Netherlands.
about.body:
Most people arrive a little nervous, so we don't rush. A session starts with a walk and a conversation, and the photographs come once the camera has stopped being the point — usually about ten minutes in.

What I look for is the version of you your friends would recognise: a real laugh, a quiet moment between two people, the way someone stands when they've forgotten to pose. Portraits, couples, graduations, families, the occasional company evening — and I travel for the ones worth travelling for.

If that's the kind of picture you want, tell me the date and roughly where you had in mind.

investment.body: Every session is quoted on the date, the hours and the travel. Send me the details, or take the guide — it has every inclusion and the current investment.
